description: Sets the brand's look, the design language every picture and film Marsell makes stays inside: a summary in a few plain sentences, its aesthetics by their common names (Swiss modernism, Y2K, glossy 3D render…), its design rules, and optionally its motifs, typography, photography and what would break it. The colours and fonts come from fill_setup. It replaces the look Marsell would otherwise read from the site.

motifs.description: Shapes, characters and marks that recur.

photography.description: How its photographs and imagery look.

rules.description: The brand's own design rules, each as the guide writes it.

summary.description: The design language in a few plain sentences.

typography.description: How its type is set, in words: weights, cases, spacing.
